segments.sn7.16:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena paccanīkasāto nāma brāhmaṇo sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasati.
segments.sn7.16:1.5: Yaṃ yadeva samaṇo gotamo bhāsissati taṃ tadevassāhaṃ [tadeva sāhaṃ (ka.)] paccanīkāssa”nti [paccanīkassanti (pī.), paccanīkasātanti (ka.)].
segments.sn7.16:1.6: Tena kho pana samayena bhagavā abbhokāse caṅkamati.
segments.sn7.16:1.7: Atha kho paccanīkasāto brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ caṅkamantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn7.16:3.4: sa ve [sace (syā. kaṃ. ka.)] jaññā subhāsita”nti.
segments.sn7.16:4.1: Evaṃ vutte, paccanīkasāto brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn7.16:4.3: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gata”nti. 7.

lines: Chaṭṭhe “sabbaṃ seta”nti vutte “sabbaṃ kaṇha”ntiādinā nayena paccanīkaṃ karontassevassa sātaṃ sukhaṃ hotīti paccanīkasāto.
Yo ca vineyya sārambhanti yo karaṇuttariyalakkhaṇaṃ sārambhaṃ vinetvā suṇātīti attho.
“Sabbaṃ seta”nti kenaci vutte tassa paccanīkaṃ karontasseva assa brāhmaṇassa.
Suṇātīti atthoti “suṇātī”ti kiriyāpadaṃ āharitvā gāthāya attho veditabbo “jaññā subhāsita”nti vuttattā.
Na hi asutvā desitaṃ jānituṃ sakkonti.
